# LOG-3: A library logs its own data, under its own log bit

- A controller or sensor library writes the messages that describe it, with its own enable bit and rate, rather than leaving the vehicle or another library to log it.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Logging and GCS Messages](../claude/CLAUDE.md#logging-and-gcs-messages). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
